mapper.insert: insert into refund_record (order_id, refund_no, refund_amount, refund_status, reason, channel, transaction_id, applied_at, success_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{refundNo}, #{refundAmount}, #{refundStatus}, #{reason}, #{channel}, #{transactionId}, #{appliedAt}, #{successAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
